label: r4-hidden-payload-600
source:
table rooms:
  public
  insert <- allow
  sync public
table notes:
  room: rooms
  shelf: shelves ?
  mark: int default 0
  shots: [image <=1000] <=0 ?
  public
  insert <- allow
  sync public
table readers:
  room: rooms
  watermark: int default 0
  cap 50 by room
  public
  insert <- allow
  sync public
query rows():
  return notes first 100 by byId

table shelves:
  public
  insert <- allow
  sync public

effect pinged
table profiles:
  name: text <=2000
  public
  online only

mutation burst():
  insert notes {room: 'c', shots: null}
  for n in range(0, 600):
    emit pinged { n, label: sha256(profiles['p'].name ?? '') }
